scripts.dev:emulators: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-casa "VITE_USE_EMULATORS=true VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY=demo-key VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=demo-casa VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=localhost vite --host --port 5175"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.sw.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tests/rules/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-casa "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:functions
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:web && FUNCTIONS_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT=120 firebase deploy --only functions
